purpose: Teach: キヤノン/ジョージア/ミシガン/オハイオ/ジャスコ/早川書房/皇居/東北大学

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがキヤノン製カメラで撮ってこられた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Dad used to take photographs with his Canon camera.
lines.style: Soft, searching tone. Voice trails into memory. Long pause before speaking, as if reaching back through decades. Gentle and unhurried.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ジョージア缶コーヒーがお好きだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear—and Grandpa was so fond of Georgia canned coffee, wasn't he?
lines.style: Warm, slightly playful interjection. A little breathless with her own memory. She's gently redirecting, not correcting. Affectionate on 'dear'.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがミシガン州に駐在された
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Dad was stationed in Michigan for work.
lines.style: Continuing the same soft reverie. A little less certain this time—searching for the exact memory. Voice thins slightly on the place name.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、オハイオ州出張のお話されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear—you told me about that trip to Ohio, didn't you?
lines.style: Gently insistent, warm correction wrapped in affection. She's testing his memory or playfully rerouting the conversation. Light on the challenge.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、ジャスコ百貨店で買い物した
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, we used to shop at the Jusco department store.
lines.style: Same reflective register. Voice settles into the ordinary detail of it. A small smile underneath—everyday nostalgia, not grand.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、早川書房の文庫を集められたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear—and you collected all those Hayakawa paperbacks, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm recognition. She's caught him in another memory now. Voice brightens slightly, pleased with the connection. Still gentle, still tender.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが皇居参賀に出かけられた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Dad would go pay respects at the imperial palace on New Year's.
lines.style: The same wistful cadence, but heavier now. A moment of reverence in the voice. Slower pace. He's reaching for something that matters.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、東北大学にご縁があったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear—and you had ties to Tohoku University, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, satisfied closure. She's collected all his memories now. Voice is gentle but complete. A small breath of contentment at the end. Affectionate finality.
